About

Krittin Leewanich is a student and a creative technologist based in Bangkok, Thailand.
His work focuses on geographic and visual data systems, exploring how maps, images, and open technologies shape human understanding of space and shared environments.

About Me

Hi, I'm Krittin Leewanich, a Computer Science student at Chulalongkorn University in Bangkok, Thailand.

I'm passionate about data mining and distributed systems. My work focuses on building scalable solutions and extracting meaningful insights from complex datasets.

When I'm not coding, you can find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, or learning about emerging trends in AI and cloud computing.
